# SPI payload benchmark — DPT

Current source: **F103 SPI master → C6 SPI slave**, DPT 14 B header + opaque payload + 4 B CRC. SPI adds two zero bytes after CRC; UDP/bin exclude padding. See [wire protocol](FRAME_PROTOCOL.md) and [mock wiring](camera_spi_mock/PROTOCOL.md).

**Legacy binaries:** bench_artifacts contains old frame-format / C6-master / F103-slave images. They are not regenerated by this migration and must not be combined with current firmware or the DPT PC tool. Rebuild both targets.

| Format | Opaque payload B | Logical F B | SPI W B | UDP parts | Wire time @9 MHz |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0x01 | 6912 | 6930 | 6932 | 6 | 6.1618 ms |
| 0x02 | 9216 | 9234 | 9236 | 8 | 8.2098 ms |
| 0x03 | 14900 | 14918 | 14920 | 13 | 13.2622 ms |

Match CAM_TEST_FORMAT and DEPTH_TEST_FORMAT; source defaults to 3. All three profiles select only payload size. They define no width/height/units and produce no preview or PGM. F103 fills every profile with (i*17+seq*13)&0xff. The type byte magic=0x01 means DPT; the format byte selects one of these sizes. Other values are undefined and currently rejected. Update source, C6 and PC together.

F103 drives PA5/SCK, PA7/MOSI and PA6/CS to C6 GPIO4 (aligned with Apollo PA3/CS). Move the old CS connection from GPIO2 to GPIO4; C6 MISO/GPIO2 is unused. SPI Mode 0, 8 bit, MSB first, APB2 72 MHz / 8 = 9 MHz, 33/33/34 ms pacing for an average target of 30 fps. No READY feedback.

C6 prequeues up to three RX buffers, each W+4 bytes (four guard bytes are not sent); SPI sends W, UDP/bin contain F. CRC covers DPT header+payload. PDK1 outer framing remains 40 B + up to 1200 B per fragment. The header order is uint8 magic, uint8 format, then three LE uint32 fields (seq, camera_ms, payload_bytes). The inner/outer sequence uses DPT offset 2.

Current images: build/Power_Deck.bin (app 0x10000) and camera_spi_mock/build/Debug/camera_spi_mock.elf/.bin (F103 0x08000000), or Release. Use the full project flash workflow where required.

After WiFi/PC discovery, compare counter increments, unique frame sequences, invalid/incomplete, drop reasons and heap/stack usage. A short first trial is sufficient for bring-up; compiling or receiving repeated frames does not prove unique sensor 30 fps. No READY means reset/overload can lose frames.
